```{r}
# download packages 
library(RColorBrewer)
library(spatstat)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
# Path to data 
path_to_data <- "C:/Users/aasie/OneDrive/Documentos/GIS713-Homework2"
```


```{r}
# Import data
paracou_shp <- shapefile(file.path(path_to_data, "paracou.shp"))
paracou_window <- shapefile(file.path(path_to_data, "paracou_window.shp"))
```

```{r}
names(paracou_shp)
names(paracou_window)
```
```{r}
# Calculate diameter at breast height from BasalArea 
paracou_shp$DBH <- sqrt((paracou_shp$BasalArea/pi) *2)
print(paracou_shp)
```


```{r}
#1: Create a map of the tree locations with symbol sizes proportional to diameter at breast height, and which distinguishes V. Americana and Q. Rosea from each other and other species.
plot(paracou_shp, col= paracou_shp$DBH)
```
